parent_goal: Prove point-in-time industrial memory transfers across genuinely different industries without collapsing time, authority or comparability semantics, then move from internal benchmark correctness toward researcher understanding.

benchmarks.role_in_falsification: broad industrial-semantic discovery and historical-recovery method pressure
proved: Blind model-memory artifacts can be isolated from Evidence authority and sealed by measured novelty decay rather than arbitrary lead count.
Post-seal fresh search can be restricted to a sealed shard without rewriting the blind historical vintage.

Real industrial history pressures generic semantics such as capacity state chains, project maturity, effective versus nameplate supply, qualification/adoption states, role-validity, inventory, price comparability and competing expectation vintages.
did_not_prove: The lithium campaign did not execute the later mature CAP-0001 through CAP-0007 full Evidence-to-Reality/Judgment/Outcome trajectory stack across the whole industry.
Its broad schema-pressure conclusions are design evidence, not publishable industry truth.

benchmarks.role_in_falsification: second-industry falsification of evidence, temporal, role-identity and within-product branching primitives
proved: Structured JSON Evidence can remain exact and fail closed without being coerced into visible text.
Reality, contemporaneous Judgment and later Outcome remain separate under no-lookahead replay across opposite clinical trajectories.
Parent company, rights holder, trial sponsor/collaborator and product-branch identities can remain distinct without a pharma-specific schema.
Valid time, observed-at state and later-known recap time remain distinct across approval, safety, biomarker and registry branches.
The selected second-industry pressure set required no new generic schema and justified reusable orchestration instead of more local ADC cases.

benchmarks.role_in_falsification: third-industry falsification of lifecycle-state, Judgment-revision, direct-versus-related Outcome and temporal-precision boundaries
proved: Development, sampling, mass/volume production, customer supply, platform shipment, market availability and qualification can remain distinct states.
A later Judgment can narrow an earlier target without rewriting either historical assertion.
A related later milestone can remain Grounded Evidence or an indeterminate related Outcome rather than being forced into direct realization.
A direct realized Outcome can preserve coarse month precision or unknown onset and remain timing-not-comparable instead of manufacturing day-level or start-date precision.
Existing generic source/Evidence/Reality/Judgment/Outcome/replay/orchestration owners handled the bounded third benchmark without a semiconductor-specific semantic owner.
residual_non_blocking_evidence_gaps: Direct primary proof of NVIDIA H200 calendar-Q2 2024 shipment start.
Completed named-customer or named-platform Samsung HBM3E 12H qualification.

cross_industry_findings.reasoning: The first benchmark generated broad industrial counterexamples and hardened the Memory-first/seal method; the second and third genuinely different industries then exercised the mature generic epistemic primitives under different source types, role structures, lifecycle states and Outcome relationships without forcing a new semantic subsystem. The benchmarks are complementary falsification stages rather than three identical runner executions.
repeated_semantics: contemporaneous Judgment preserved independently of later Reality
revision/trajectory preservation instead of hindsight overwrite
stop local benchmark expansion when marginal architecture value falls

mission_alignment_gap.gap: The repository has safe CAP-0005 researcher read surfaces for industry orientation, trajectory replay, open states and Evidence drilldown, but there is not yet a governed real-industry path that materializes source-grounded industry membership from an already-selected Fact resolution into the orientation catalog. The current PostgreSQL orientation hard smoke manually inserts core.industry_entity_memberships after reconciliation and explicitly uses synthetic fixtures.
mission_alignment_gap.why_it_matters: Without this bridge, real benchmark epistemic memory cannot yet be entered through the same source-grounded industry-first surface that the product mission expects. Passing internal trajectory benchmarks therefore does not yet prove that a researcher can rapidly build a defensible industry mental model from real archived history.
existing_owners_to_reuse: CAP-0003 for Fact reconciliation/resolution truth and Evidence-backed assertion identity
CAP-0005 for industry orientation, point-in-time memory visibility, trajectory/open-state presentation and no-lookahead boundaries
mission_alignment_gap.minimum_safe_next_step: Replace the manual membership materialization step with a typed, idempotent projection that accepts only an already-selected industry.membership Fact resolution, validates entity/industry/role/Evidence consistency fail closed, and writes core.industry_entity_memberships without reinterpreting reconciliation truth. Then use one real completed benchmark to prove orient -> replay/open-states -> Evidence drilldown at a shared cutoff.
negative_cases_required: Reject a resolution whose selected assertion predicate is not industry.membership.
Reject missing or ambiguous selected assertions.
Reject membership assertions without supporting Evidence.
Reject an industry-node identity that is absent or inconsistent with the selected assertion metadata.
Do not use system_from/resolved_at as historical known_at.
Do not let presentation create membership truth or infer value-chain importance.

next_action: Extend existing CAP-0003/CAP-0005 paths with a typed source-grounded industry-membership projection, remove the manual SQL membership step from the PostgreSQL orientation smoke, and after that execute one real-industry researcher-entry acceptance proof before considering another benchmark or broader UI work.
